nw._note: mDNS must be enabled for Home Assistant auto-discovery. Hostname: reefs.local

ap._note: AP SSID shown on first boot. Configure Wi-Fi via captive portal — never commit credentials here.

leds._maxpwr_note: PSU rated 10A (50W). Hard limit per output set in WLED web UI to 4000mA each.
leds._bp_note: Boot preset 1 — warm ambient. Set in WLED: LED Preferences → Boot Preset.
